about: Phase 2 proposal inputs (P2-R2): the eight sponsored pages named in CLAUDE-BRIEF-PHASE2.md, the manifest placement for each, and a per-page edit plan produced by a promotional-content audit. Every edit names the exact source text it expects; the build refuses to run if any expected text is missing, duplicated or changed. IDs, destinations, addresses and URLs are NOT set here; scripts/build-proposal.mjs takes them from seed/pilot-manifest.json and refuses anything held, unknown or cross-tenant.
label: Sponsored pilot
disclosure: No-fee pilot placement. WaterWiseKids may offer paid sponsored placements in the future. Sponsorship does not change directory order or editorial content.
instruction: Check current schedules, pricing and enrollment directly with the school.
